description: Arrange the production pipeline components in the correct implementation order.
instructions: Think about production-grade setup: What makes the pipeline environment-agnostic? What's the entry point for raw data? Pattern: config → ingest → CDC → quality gates → error handling → observability.

blocks.code: SELECT CASE WHEN data_freshness > INTERVAL 15 MINUTES THEN 'SLA_BREACH' END FROM freshness_check
blocks.label: SLA Freshness Monitoring

hints: Parameterize first — all other steps depend on the environment
Bronze ingestion is the entry point for raw data
CDC applies updates to build the current state table
Quality checks ensure Gold table integrity
Dead letter queue captures records that fail processing
SLA monitoring is the final observability layer
learnings: Spark Declarative Pipelines are declarative - define what, not how
dp.expect_or_fail() enforces data quality at each step
Pipeline event log captures execution history
Monitoring alerts on freshness and failures
Import as: from pyspark import pipelines as dp
